VERDICT: ok

Checked against the sketch and the screenshots:

- Schematic match: battery B1 on the left source branch, potentiometer RV1 on the right wired as a series divider (vcc → r1 → n1 wiper → r2 → gnd), wiper brought out to a pair of marked open terminals on the right, ground reference on the bottom rail — every sketch element present, same topology, same left-to-right layout.
- States: Fixed and "As drawn" both render correctly; as-drawn shows the open/dangling output annotation and "no value" labels, Fixed shows the explicit 9 V / 10.00 kΩ values; mistake statuses flip between "Present in sketch" and "Fixed in build" as toggled. Mode toggle, chips, and notes all agree.
- Readings agree with hand-checked MNA (9 V, 10 kΩ + 0.2 Ω internal, 50 % wiper): V(vcc) ≈ 8.9998 V → "9.00 V", V(n1) ≈ 4.50 V, loop current ≈ 0.89998 mA → "900.0 µA", powers ≈ 8.100 mW — consistent with the reference solver reporting no disagreements.
- Current dots: only on the closed loop (source branch, top rail, divider zigzag, bottom stub/rail), moving in conventional-current direction, none on the open wiper branch — correct.
- window.__sim: defined synchronously before load ends; setMode/setSwitch/setValue/setPosition present; state() returns mode, all nets (gnd, vcc, n1) and all part ids (B1, RV1, GND1) with battery current delivered out of +, voltage as nodes[0]−nodes[1]; no JS errors visible.
- Text/labels: net labels (vcc, n1, gnd), part values, red drawn-mode annotations, terminal +/− marks, and "open output" notes are all legible with no overlaps; wiper-dependent labels/brackets reposition correctly with the wiper slider.
